title: Adversarial fuzz session: all workers passed
subtitle: Template-rendered worker panels in one generated HTML report
summary_html:
One primary coordinator dispatched four independent workers. Each worker ran one bounded fuzz task and returned a structured result; the report sections are the exact XHTML panels rendered from the worker-panel template.

sections.title: shape-probe
sections.summary: The shape worker exercised recorded structured-input cases. The real jagged-array fixture used rows [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5]] and produced the expected two-row output.
sections.context_text: Successful shape-probe session: 12 iterations, including shape-probe-002 with rows [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5]], all passed.
